audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill/Maokai/Maokai/Skill/Skill/Maokai/Maokai; the mirror resolved rows 3 and 4 to Maokai and row 6 to Swain.
audit.why: whys[3] and whys[4] both describe Maokai out-sustaining through those stages, and whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say a two-item Swain cannot be killed by him — so the last row contradicted the page's own text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twisted Advance is called 'point-and-click' with no mention that he is untargetable during it, no cooldowns appear anywhere, and wants.foe[1] calls his passive 'Nature's Grasp'.
audit.why: Riot text: Twisted Advance is 14/13/12/11/10s — he 'contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target', rooting on arrival. Burst spent into that dash is wasted. His passive is Sap Magic, which heals him and whose cooldown drops each time he casts a spell OR is struck by one — so poking him accelerates his own sustain. Nature's Grasp is the 130s R wall. Sapling Toss is 18s at 1100 range and is more effective in brush.
audit.corrected: Untargetability, all four cooldowns and the correct passive name written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, phases[3].why, phases[4].why, whys[1] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] lists anti-heal but the content layer never names the timing, and wants.you[2] told the player to burn R reactively instead.
audit.why: Sap Magic refunds health off every spell in the exchange, including the ones you throw at him — Grievous Wounds before his first item is what makes the poke phase mean anything.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb timing written into wants.you[2].

audit.why: All three packet suspectNames ('Land Twisted Advance', 'Bait Twisted Advance', "Demonic Ascension's") are false positives — the matcher caught leading verbs and a possessive. The one genuinely wrong name was 'passive Nature's Grasp', which the matcher missed.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Twisted Advance's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His grind: Sap Magic refunds health off every spell he casts or eats, so his sustain beats your poke. Farm and hold E for 6.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension turns his all-in into your healing — bait it, then drain. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Maokai's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Twisted Advance turns him untargetable mid-dash, so any burst thrown into it is wasted — wait the dash out, then drain him once he lands.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Maokai carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: fragment HP and permanent drain mean he cannot kill you — take the 1v1, deny his R in fights.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance: matchup-defining — His lock-on root. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twisted Advance: 14s at rank 1 — he is untargetable during the dash, so hold your burst until he lands. - Sapling Toss: 18s, 1100 range, stronger in brush. - Nature's Grasp: 130s wall that can cut your retreat.

edits.before: Track Maokai's Twisted Advance (Root): His lock-on root. Dodge it. When it is down — E-root + R him.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is 14s and he is untargetable during it — hold burst, then E-root and drain when he lands.

edits.before: His lock-on root. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 14s targeted dash — untargetable in flight. Commit after it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Saplings are 18s and hit harder in brush — do not brawl on top of one.

edits.before: Twisted Advance goes point-and-click: he roots you, lines up his sapping sapling, and heals it back through passive — your kit has no reliable answer at this exact level.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is a targeted dash he rides untargetable, then roots you for the sapling — and Sap Magic heals the damage back. You have no answer yet.

edits.before: Use his passive Nature's Grasp sustain to survive the early poke war and outlast your mana pool
edits.after: Lean on Sap Magic's per-spell healing to survive the early poke war and outlast your mana pool

edits.before: Activate Demonic Ascension the instant he roots you so your drain converts his passive healing into a net loss for him
edits.after: Buy Oblivion Orb before his first item — Sap Magic refunds off every spell, and Grievous Wounds is what makes your poke stick

notes: Sap Magic's cooldown drops when Maokai is struck by a spell as well as when he casts one, which means Swain's own poke feeds the enemy's sustain — that is the real reason the early grind goes his way, and it now has a home in phases[3].why. Voice issue the mirror also raised: several content strings on the maokai pages are written in first person ('My W root into Q'); none of the strings I edited here were, but a champion-wide voice pass is still warranted.
